_readme: Hand corrections keyed by the entry's source URL. Each value may have: add (tags to add), remove (tags to remove), primaryCategory (replaces the badge category). Valid tags: Full Robot, Drivetrain (Mecanum/Tank), Swerve Drive, Intake, Claw / Gripper, Linear Slides / Extension, Turret, Shooter, Differential / PTO, Dead Axle Wheel, Vector Wheel, Camera Mount, Drone Launcher, Number Plate / Misc. After editing, run: npm run build-data
